title: Inkumville Farm - Country living in the city!
description:
Minutes from downtown Nashville, Opryland and the Airport while still on 14+ acres.
With roots as an old dairy farm,  Inkumville Farm  offers a place to stay  and exhale. Our on‑farm lodging is designed for guests who crave peace, simplicity, and a deeper connection to nature. A quiet personal retreat, a romantic getaway, or a restorative weekend with family or friends, our farm invites you to slow down and savor the beauty of farm life. 
4 Bedrooms, 4 living areas, 2 Kitchens, Gazebo, trail
